title: Unpack a supported optical instrument without dropping it
instruction: Unpack the instrument onto its service stand and put the shipping foam in the packing tray, keeping the instrument supported throughout.
context: This narrow-foot optical module requires its matching service base for operation. Its shaped shipping cradle carries it during transport; a loose protective cap only covers the optics. Transfer it directly to the ready service base before clearing the cradle.
setup: Fixed YAM station with two parallel grippers. A 350 g rigid optical instrument (about 155 x 100 x 194 mm including its carry handle) rests 40 mm above the table on a 120 g shaped foam cradle at x=0.34,y=0.09 m. A separate 40 g foam cap covers its optics. An anchored 180 x 150 mm service stand is at x=0.34,y=-0.17 m; an anchored 240 x 300 mm packing tray is at x=0.56,y=0.10 m. Both foam pieces share the same graphite material. Geometry, dimensions and fixed poses are declared in task.py; no object jitter.
scoring: End score. Any instrument tilt beyond 25 degrees or unsupported downward travel beyond 30 mm latches zero. Otherwise 0.5 requires its foot supported by the service stand, origin within 25 mm of stand center, tilt under 10 degrees, speed below 15 mm/s and angular speed below 0.10 rad/s, released for one second. Score 1.0 additionally requires all geometry of both foam parts within the tray's inner horizontal footprint (1 mm tolerance), above its floor and below 230 mm above table, each moving below 20 mm/s and 0.12 rad/s, with all conditions held one second. Grippers must be at least 65 mm from all designated handles. Support/drop measurement is specified in SCORING.md.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz (120 seconds simulation).
reset_notes: A fresh reset restores the fixed layout and clears all failure and stability history.
fidelity: Compound rigid bodies with gravity, friction and robot contact in PhysX. Foam is a rigid proxy; optics, compliance and damage are not simulated. Support and grasp retention are measured conservatively from poses, gripper opening and relative motion rather than force sensing. The action-only demo has no object teleports or attachments.
scores: Dream-1 beta: 0.0 (2400 steps); scripted physical demo: 1.0 (1665 steps).
